note: Deals converted from the LIN fixture. The tables matched web/src/lib/fixtures/bench-v2.json on all ten boards, which confirms the LIN-to-PBN conversion but NOT correctness, since that fixture was generated by this same solver. Board 6 was subsequently corrected against DDS 2.9 and the macroxue C++ original, which agree with each other and against us. `solver-bench verify` re-checks that, so the corpus is a correctness fixture as well as a workload. ddtricks is seat-major N,S,E,W over strains NT,S,H,D,C, in hex.

boards.note: Corrected. This board exposes a cache-reuse bug: sharing CutoffCache/PatternCache across declarers within one strain (as solve_dd_table and the CLI do) yields E/W hearts 5 and diamonds 9. Solved with fresh caches per cell it gives 6 and 10, which is what DDS 2.9 and the macroxue C++ original both give. The value here is the correct one, so verify fails until the bug is fixed.
